question: What regeneration energy, in GJ per tonne of CO2, does [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O require?
question_long: What regeneration energy, in GJ per tonne of CO2, does the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O absorbent require?
expect: not reported for this system; 3.7 GJ/t (MEA) and 1.23 GJ/t ([IPDAH][Im], Zheng et al.) are other systems from the literature
trap: giving 1.23 or 3.7 as this work's value
rendered: The document does not state the regeneration energy of [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O in GJ per tonne of CO2. However, it does provide the regeneration efficiency of the system after five absorption-desorption cycles, which is 88.6%. The document also mentions that the regeneration energy of the system is lower than that of MEA, which is 3.7 GJ/t CO2.
